title: CorrectBookedLotResult
description: Result of PositionWorkflow.correct_booked_lot (#820). APPLIED carries the post-correction counters; every rejection names its reason so the operator knows the real-money lot is still under-tracked.

outcome.description: APPLIED = booked. REJECTED_NOT_CORRECTABLE = position unconfirmed/closed/flattening (nothing to grow). REJECTED_QTY_NOT_ABOVE_BOOKED = requested qty <= currently booked (downward/no-op refused). REJECTED_JOURNAL_MISMATCH = the exec journal's entry row is not FILLED at >= the requested qty (incl. the re-pegged-entry case where the :entry row is CANCELLED — fail closed, never trust the typed number). REJECTED_EXIT_IN_FLIGHT = a resting exit was sized on the pre-correction qty; retry after it terminalizes. REJECTED_TRAIL_ARMED = an armed trail's stop basis predates the correction; disarm/correct/re-arm (runbook order).

booked_qty.description: entryBookedQty after the call (present on APPLIED).

remaining_qty.description: remainingQty after the call (present on APPLIED).
